tests.target: future backup domain and adapter contract tests
tests.description: Validate that recipe execution delegates to configured real adapters and rejects unsupported or unconfigured backend operations without embedding storage-engine behavior in Bahia.
Inject EVENT, EOSE, OK, CLOSED, and AUTH messages to verify event-driven backup run processing, publish acceptance checks, rejection handling, dedupe, and no sleep-based completion.
Assert that a snapshot with failed or missing verification is projected as unverified and is not eligible as a verified restore candidate.
Inject restore request and approval/rejection events and verify adapter execution only occurs after required approval, with signed terminal restore result provenance.
Verify scoped subscriptions, EOSE historical catch-up, replay dedupe, CLOSED handling, AUTH-required failure/reauthentication, and partial relay OK outcomes across backup workflow events.
Validate that the documented backup namespace is internally consistent, avoids known collisions with 31200 and 38395/38396, and includes command/result/read-model/status/attestation tag contracts.
evidence: Repository search for allocated backup kinds found no production-path collisions; matches were limited to this planning/export material, logs, or unrelated checksum text before docs were updated.
JSON validation passed for feature_spec.json, acceptance_criteria.json, and test_matrix.json after namespace allocation updates.

known_gaps: No backup implementation code exists in this docs/protocol slice; implementation tests remain planned for later Beads issues.
Backend-specific test harnesses must be selected after the first adapter slice is chosen.

implementation_notes: Implementation slices must consume backup commands 38400-38409 and results 38410-38419 rather than 31200 or 38395/38396.
Prefer Kopia for the first generic filesystem backup adapter unless human decision chooses Velero or a native snapshot adapter first.
Velero must be treated as a Kubernetes orchestration adapter, not something Bahia reimplements.
Do not introduce filesystem_mock into production backup paths; test doubles must remain test-only and deterministic.
